symbols.name: PATCH
symbols.sig: export async function PATCH( _request: Request, _ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },)
doc: I moved PATCH and DELETE to the Announcement Manager (src/lib/announcements/admin): it checks the authority in the DATABASE on every request (a revoked delegate loses the right at once), holds the facility lock, protects against a lost update with the record version and writes an audit row. The old handlers here checked only "ticket starts with 4 and is the author": no audit, no version, and a withdrawn delegate could keep editing and deleting.
